All events share a probability space; D and not-D partition the population.
P(D)=0.02, P(not-D)=0.98, P(+|D)=0.90, and P(+|not-D)=0.05.
The false-positive rate changed from 0.10 in version 1 to 0.05 in version 2.
P(+)=0.90*0.02+0.05*0.98=0.067>0.
P(D|+)=0.018/0.067=18/67.
Version-1 posterior 9/58 does not apply to this new question data.
